summary_md: **Pipeline Mag ([@pipeline_mag](https://x.com/pipeline_mag/status/2116140622587322757))** summarizes *When Modernization Breaks Working Code* ([arXiv 2610.40269](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40269)): of 100 legacy WordPress PHP files, 83 passed all behavioral checks untouched, yet five LLMs each broke 32–51 of them versus 7 for the Rector tool.
